rewritten_query:
WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_county,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_qoy = 1 THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price END) AS ss_q1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_qoy = 2 THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price END) AS ss_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_qoy = 3 THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price END) AS ss_q3
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_color IN ('light', 'midnight')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
      AND ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 286 AND 300
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('NM', 'TN')
      AND d.d_year = 2000
      AND d.d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca.ca_county, d.d_year
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_county,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_qoy = 1 THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS ws_q1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_qoy = 2 THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS ws_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_qoy = 3 THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS ws_q3
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_color IN ('light', 'midnight')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
      AND ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 286 AND 300
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('NM', 'TN')
      AND d.d_year = 2000
      AND d.d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca.ca_county, d.d_year
)
SELECT
    s.ca_county,
    s.d_year,
    w.ws_q2 / w.ws_q1 AS web_q1_q2_increase,
    s.ss_q2 / s.ss_q1 AS store_q1_q2_increase,
    w.ws_q3 / w.ws_q2 AS web_q2_q3_increase,
    s.ss_q3 / s.ss_q2 AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM store_agg s
JOIN web_agg w
  ON s.ca_county = w.ca_county
 AND s.d_year = w.d_year
WHERE CASE WHEN w.ws_q1 > 0 THEN w.ws_q2 / w.ws_q1 ELSE NULL END
        > CASE WHEN s.ss_q1 > 0 THEN s.ss_q2 / s.ss_q1 ELSE NULL END
  AND CASE WHEN w.ws_q2 > 0 THEN w.ws_q3 / w.ws_q2 ELSE NULL END
        > CASE WHEN s.ss_q2 > 0 THEN s.ss_q3 / s.ss_q2 ELSE NULL END
ORDER BY s.ca_county;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The original CTEs 'ss' and 'ws' are each referenced three times, causing six CTE scans and five self-joins. Replace these repeated self-joins with conditional aggregation (SUM(CASE WHEN d_qoy = ...)) that pivots quarters 1–3 into columns, reducing the final query to a single join between two aggregated CTEs (rewrite score 9/10).

Push the final filters d_year = 2000 and d_qoy IN (1,2,3) down into both fact-table aggregations instead of aggregating all years/quarters and filtering afterwards, reducing aggregation input rows (rewrite score 8/10).

Convert the comma-style joins into explicit ANSI JOINs, and collapse the six-way self-join of quarters into one equality join on (ca_county, d_year) between store and web aggregates (rewrite score 7/10).

Preserve the original zero-denominator semantics by keeping the CASE-based ratio comparisons in the outer WHERE; the conditions also implicitly enforce that all six quarter aggregates exist (non-null), matching the original inner-join requirement for every quarter row (rewrite score 6/10).
